suggested_body:
> Implementation: GPT-6 Astra. Independent review and authoritative CI evidence are recorded separately below.

Reuse a reached non-bind RHS relation for the same prepared pattern and requested sort across capped seed blocks. Armed budgets retain the original scan lifetime, and stale sort entries are released before a replacement scan. Per-block planning, bind decisions, and hash builds remain unchanged.

Refs #3105. This completes the scan-reuse slice; planner and hash-build reuse remain open.
